rulings_candidates.text: The living chart ships default-off behind hash param living=1 and a layers-panel row, like R18 and ST7. The layers-panel row and the "still chart" control render only when living=1, or each unit declares the panel region under UG8 (docs/mobile/README.md:29) as R18 did; default-off alone does not keep desktop identity.
rulings_candidates.why: UG10 bytes stay untouched; UG8 holds only if the panel row and control are living=1-only or declared

rulings_candidates.text: One visible 'still chart' control stops every ambient motion at once; it initialises from prefers-reduced-motion and follows its change event. It also governs journey playback and .route-line.playing, and reads the existing jReduceMq/jReduced() (maps-site/index.html:3091-3092), not a second matchMedia.
rulings_candidates.default: still when the OS asks for reduced motion, else moving once living=1
rulings_candidates.why: WCAG 2.2.2 needs a visible mechanism; the media query alone only covers 2.3.3

rulings_candidates.text: Under reduced motion or 'still', the chart freezes on one fixed frame: footprints as static stamps, ships moored, water frozen, creatures perched or absent, zoom effects instant.
rulings_candidates.why: reduce means calmer, not emptier; matches the capture posture (frozen clock)

rulings_candidates.text: Moving creatures are limited to canon-backed kinds: Loon Sea whales (canon) and birds (inferred). Lugal is a static glyph at the Fell Mountains drawn from canon data. Hoarwyrms and Witch-Birds are still, named glyphs or owner-gated (their behaviours are invented-behaviour); Ponbar beasts are not shown (unresolved in canon). Dragon flocks are out unless the owner rules them in.
rulings_candidates.why: canon withholds the Ponbar beasts and gives the Far North creatures a name only; the extract holds one dragon, Lugal

rulings_candidates.text: Footprints follow the party route only, in session order; teleport legs are drawn as a sea leg or a gap, never a walk; per-member tints only where road[] resolves to a route stop.
rulings_candidates.why: the route is canon-approximate and not dated by day; the member trails are conjectural

rulings_candidates.text: Caravans and ships on the atlas come from a fixed-seed sim snapshot; outside the Epēshu window they come from a seeded atlas function watermarked prov invented. Seeded atlas function inputs: a constant seed literal, and day = the snapshot's day plus the rAF-timestamp presentation clock (never wall-clock). Dragon flights are dropped (Lugal is a static canon glyph; B-41 muster_day is not reused for flights). The snapshot extends R12 (Filigree-owned, frozen by Filigree 2): reserve a versioned field for it in the Option C Filigree 2 input now, or ship a separate living= snapshot file instead of notices=. Visible text uses a display-noun map (sim kind:'cog' -> mūskar or galley).
rulings_candidates.default: snapshot inside the window, invented outside
rulings_candidates.why: the atlas has no sim day; an unstated day invites wall-clock time, which breaks determinism and R12; the snapshot format is a real file-ownership collision

rulings_candidates.text: The sim is the only 3D: the atlas hands off to the street view (H2) by deep link; no WebGL in maps-site unless an owner-gated H1 spike is approved. The hand-off is H2z: a crossfade into the Street frozen-view poster, then the H2 link (owner question: is a page change acceptable?).
rulings_candidates.why: one engine, zero atlas bytes, Street already owns street life

rulings_candidates.text: Ambient motion runs at 15-20 fps (30 max on phones), only while visible, on band and with the layer on.
rulings_candidates.why: battery at the table; iOS Low Power Mode clamps to 30 anyway

rulings_candidates.text: Motion stays slow, low-contrast and out of label boxes; nothing alerts.
rulings_candidates.why: ambient-display literature (hypothesis) and the owner's 'not distracting from names'

rulings_candidates.text: Structures appear at the city band by the R6 threshold rule; no GoT-style rise or scale-pop.
rulings_candidates.why: R6 / the density-bible appear clause forbid fade-in from nothing

The atlas also has jrn.forceReduced and the visible #jbar-reduce box; the still-chart control writes jrn.forceReduced (LC2), so no second state is added.

corrections.research: dashmove and copulse lack reduced-motion CSS.
corrections.correction: dashmove loops infinitely (2.2.2 scope); copulse runs a finite pulse. Both get the @media rule in the standalone item "Atlas reduced motion for its own animations (dashmove, copulse)", outside the living track.
setHash replaces the whole hash, so living=1 is lost on the first card open unless one declared hook line keeps it (Living 2 probe P-hash-keep).

UG4 hard-fails once a /* FILIGREE */ or /* STREET */ marker exists, so every living accept file waives UG4 with a fixed reason and living-3-build re-scores its anchor, drift and tithe halves from the capture (GL.2). UG5 is waived (atlas-only capture); UG9 is waived (living strings are listed in docs/living/README.md §13, never in docs/mobile/README.md).

mobile-capture --accept without --capture writes docs/mobile/captures/<unit>.json, and a capture without --shots-dir writes docs/mobile/shots/. The living track always captures with --out and --shots-dir under docs/living/ and scores with --accept ... --capture ... --ref <name>=<file>.

tools/build-offline-manifest.js walks every file under maps-site/ (the atlas lane has no roots list), so any new or changed maps-site/ file makes --check report a stale manifest. Every maps-site/ writer of this track regenerates maps-site/data/offline-manifest.json when it exists and requires --atlas --check exit 0, and never writes maps-site/ while a Mobile lane is open (mobile-review fails a stale manifest).

The Loon Sea has no atlas coordinates: maps_markers.json has no entry and wiki-places.json holds only its page ("the most northerly region known"). Whales move only where Living 1 resolves a canon placement on the sheet (LC4); otherwise they stay off and it is an owner question.

owner_questions.q: Default off until Living 4 passes and you have looked at it on a real phone at the table, then you flip it? (default: yes, off)

Which creatures may move, where, and doing what? Name any invented creature (dragon flocks, hoarwyrm snow-ripples, Witch-Bird wheels) with its place and behaviour to rule it in; it will carry a rumour mark. Does Lugal ever fly? (default: no) Coastal birds are inferred, not backed (the lexicon has the words, the extract shows none): may they move by default unmarked, or only with the rumour mark "told, not seen"? (default: they move, unmarked, as inferred)
Footprints for the whole Company only, or each member in their colour? Teleport legs as a gap, or as a sea leg? (default: Company only, gap)

Caravans and ships everywhere from a seeded function (invented schedules), with the real sim traffic inside the Epēshu window? Every ship reads mūskar (merchantman): may some lanes read galley instead? (default: yes; mūskar everywhere)

Is a page change into the sim acceptable as the "transitive layer" when you zoom in, or must the zoom stay inside the atlas (the H1 spike)? Which landmark is the first exhibit? (defaults: yes; the Epēshīn Forum)
Are 20 and 15 draws a second smooth enough for ambient motion? (default: yes)
Is 24 css px a second the right top speed for a caravan string at the table? (default: yes)
A whole-sheet dim (canon) or a travelling shadow sweep (invented)? (default: the dim)
Accept up to 200 raw bytes of hook lines in the first view, or insist on +0 bytes (then the living chart has no way to load)? (default: accept)
May a moving caravan or ship be selected to open its card? (default: yes)
Are "Still the chart" and "Stir the chart" the words you want on the control? (default: yes)
